system.flavor:
Soften a fall from a cart, take a thrown stone without a bruise, blunt a trap's dart, or catch a dropped pot before it breaks against you.

Not enough to walk away from a long fall or a collapsing roof.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1.

surges.html: Reduce its forced movement by 1 unit.
If you accepted Strain for this card, suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.
